description: Predict Portuguese leaderboard performance across model parameter scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are acc,all, acc,exam id  2009, acc,exam id  2010, acc,exam id  2010-01, acc,exam id  2010-02, acc,exam id  2011, and 72 more.
